purpose: Persistent baseline for future Company Reality / Execution Gate. Only proven or explicitly known capabilities are marked strong. Unknowns stay unknown.

strengths.evidence: Multiple active software projects use LLM/API integrations.
FastAPI/Flask and data-processing systems have been implemented in active projects.
React/Vite dashboards and product interfaces are actively built.
Current Radar already ingests and processes multiple external data sources.
Current workflow can move from specification to working software quickly with AI coding support.

known_gaps.rule: Do not assume specialist expertise unless there is explicit evidence for that opportunity.
Treat enterprise distribution as unproven until real customer access evidence exists.
Healthcare, finance, critical infrastructure, legal/compliance-heavy opportunities require explicit expert and regulatory evidence.

execution_policy.missing_capability_is_not_always_a_block: Classify as CAN_DO, CAN_ACQUIRE, or HARD_BLOCKER.

notes: This is a starting profile, not a permanent truth.
Future evidence should update capabilities rather than letting an LLM improvise them per opportunity.
A problem can be real and valuable while still being a bad fit for the current company.

strategic_search_policy.ai_boundary: AI may increase execution capacity but cannot prove domain knowledge, buyer access, legitimacy, trust, regulation, or willingness-to-pay.

domain_adjacency_policy.rule: A market can be objectively attractive while being NOT EASON-ADDRESSABLE NOW. Do not downgrade objective market truth; gate only first-person Founder action.

credibility_policy.owned: Only explicit prior work, artifacts, customers, or demonstrated workflow experience.
credibility_policy.borrowable: A named expert/partner/customer co-design relationship may reduce a credibility gap only when explicit evidence exists.
credibility_policy.buildable: Low-trust self-serve markets may build legitimacy through a bounded product + user proof; do not assume this in enterprise or regulated markets.
credibility_policy.non_bridgeable_now: Extreme trust/regulatory burden without explicit expert/partner evidence blocks Founder action.

research_to_action_policy.rule: When core problem + buyer + durable gap are supported and remaining uncertainty is best reduced by real buyer behavior, market action may outrank more desk research.
research_to_action_policy.authority: Planning only; only observed outcomes may update calibration.
